name: Beyond Military
_source: Locked from frame-by-frame NexLev analysis of 5 Beyond Military videos (Nov 2026): xNJ4E6uohXs, WewQWuw3aaA, PS0zjfQ97zs, 7LeiKeITIe4, vbtZJ48CO-Y.

pacing._note: Observed ASL 2.2-3.5 s, min ~0.8 s, max ~6-7 s. Cuts land on sentence start or on the named noun mid-sentence.

footage._note: ~60% real archival, ~20% FLIR/targeting pod, ~10% maps, ~10% control room / cockpit screens. Literal match: exact aircraft/ship/weapon named in narration must be the one on screen.

overlays._note: Yellow box, black bold text, imperial value on top + metric below. Top-right for times, top-center for measures, top-left for system ID labels. Pop-in ~0.25 s with UI click, hold until next cut (2-4 s).

sfx._note: Every overlay pop-in gets a UI click. Map scenes open with a low whoosh + bass hit. Narrative pivots ('Unknown to...', 'But...') get a riser into a bass hit. Action words get matching one-shots (launch, flyby, explosion, gunfire, flares, radar tone, radio static, alarm). Music drops out for 0.6 s on explosions so the hit dominates.
